H0095|                                        - auto: mmap, unless a device does not support it
H0096|                                        - none: no special loading mode
H0097|                                        - mmap: memory-map model (if mmap disabled, slower load but may reduce
H0098|                                        pageouts if not using mlock)
H0099|                                        - mlock: force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or
H0100|                                        compressing

H0102|                                        swapping or compressing

H0107|                                        (default: auto)
H0108|                                        - on: read the rows of such tensors from disk on demand instead of
H0109|                                        keeping them resident (requires mmap)
H0110|                                        - auto: on, but only for tensors larger than 4 GiB
H0111|                                        - off: always keep them resident
H0112|                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_TENSOR_READ_LAZY)

H0114|                                        - distribute: spread execution evenly over all nodes
H0115|                                        - isolate: only spawn threads on CPUs on the node that execution
H0116|                                        started on
H0117|                                        - numactl: use the CPU map provided by numactl

H0418|----- example-specific params -----

H0420|-lcs,  --lookup-cache-static FNAME      path to static lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (not updated by
H0421|                                        generation)

H0423|                                        generation)
H0424|--kv-unified-per-slot N                 context limit per parallel slot (default: unset, behavior unchanged).
H0425|                                        when set without -c/--ctx-size, the shared KV pool is sized to
H0426|                                        n_parallel*N
H0427|                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_KV_UNIFIED_PER_SLOT)
H0428|-ctxcp, --ctx-checkpoints, --swa-checkpoints N

H0430|                                        32)[(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/15293)
H0431|                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_CTX_CHECKPOINTS)
H0432|-cms,  --checkpoint-min-step N          minimum spacing between context checkpoints in tokens (default: 8192,
H0433|                                        0 = no minimum)
H0434|                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_CHECKPOINT_MIN_SPACING_NT)
H0435|-cram, --cache-ram N                    set the maximum cache size in MiB (default: 8192, -1 - no limit, 0 -
H0436|                                        disable)[(more
H0437|                                        info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/16391)
H0438|                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_RAM)
H0439|-kvu,  --kv-unified, -no-kvu, --no-kv-unified
H0440|                                        use single unified KV buffer shared across all sequences (default:
H0441|                                        enabled if number of slots is auto)
H0442|                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_KV_UNIFIED)

H0694|                                        reasoning and/or tool calls (default: disabled)
H0695|                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_SKIP_CHAT_PARSING)
H0696|--prefill-assistant, --no-prefill-assistant
H0697|                                        whether to prefill the assistant's response if the last message is an
H0698|                                        assistant message (default: prefill enabled)
H0699|                                        when this flag is set, if the last message is an assistant message
H0700|                                        then it will be treated as a full message and not prefilled
H0701|
H0702|                                        (env: LLAMA_ARG_PREFILL_ASSISTANT)
H0703|-sps,  --slot-prompt-similarity SIMILARITY
H0704|                                        how much the prompt of a request must match the prompt of a slot in
H0705|                                        order to use that slot (default: 0.10, 0.0 = disabled)
H0706|--lora-init-without-apply               load LoRA adapters without applying them (apply later via POST
H0707|                                        /lora-adapters) (default: disabled)
H0708|--sleep-idle-seconds SECONDS            number of seconds of idleness after which the server will sleep
H0709|                                        (default: -1; -1 = disabled)
H0710|--log-prompts-dir PATH                  Log prompts to directory (auto-created if not present; only used for
H0711|                                        debugging, default: disabled)
H0712|--embd-gemma-default                    use default EmbeddingGemma model (note: can download weights from the
H0713|                                        internet)
H0714|--fim-qwen-1.5b-default                 use default Qwen 2.5 Coder 1.5B (note: can download weights from the
H0715|                                        internet)
H0716|--fim-qwen-3b-default                   use default Qwen 2.5 Coder 3B (note: can download weights from the
H0717|                                        internet)
H0718|--fim-qwen-7b-default                   use default Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B (note: can download weights from the
H0719|                                        internet)
H0720|--fim-qwen-7b-spec                      use Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B + 0.5B draft for speculative decoding (note: can
H0721|                                        download weights from the internet)
H0722|--fim-qwen-14b-spec                     use Qwen 2.5 Coder 14B + 0.5B draft for speculative decoding (note:
H0723|                                        can download weights from the internet)
H0724|--fim-qwen-30b-default                  use default Qwen 3 Coder 30B A3B Instruct (note: can download weights
H0725|                                        from the internet)
H0726|--gpt-oss-20b-default                   use gpt-oss-20b (note: can download weights from the internet)
